claim: Finding 8 (Big I NJ agency membership): "Big I NJ agency members pay $748-$4,350 a year in dues and are offered concrete offsets..."
problem: The cited page (biginj.org/membership/agency-membership/) lists the savings offsets but publishes no dues figures at all; $748 and $4,350 appear nowhere on it. I then opened Big I NJ's own new-member application PDF, whose dues table runs $680 (under $100k revenue) to $3,955 (over $11M revenue), which contradicts the stated range at both ends. The number is therefore unsupported by the citation and contradicted by the association's published schedule.
fix: Either delete the dues range and keep the finding about the offsets (which are confirmed: $1,500 MRP cap, 30% CE, 40% NJ Agents Conference, Sept 1 fiscal year, 1/3 and 2/3 mid-year proration), or restate it as "$680-$3,955 by revenue band" and cite https://www.biginj.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/25/2026/06/BigINJMemberApp18-19FILLFORM.pdf, flagged as a schedule still headed 2018-19 and therefore provisional.

claim: Finding 16 / resource "ACCA 2027": national ACCA contractor dues are Bronze $775, Silver $1,850, Gold $5,150 (Silver includes $900 ACCA Bucks, Gold $2,500 plus unlimited on-demand training).
problem: The figures themselves are correct, but the cited URL (https://www.acca.org/events) contains only the ACCA 2027 dates and no dues. A reader opening the citation cannot verify the numbers, and the recommendation "national contractor dues are $775-$5,150" rests on it.
fix: Cite the tier pages actually opened: https://www.acca.org/join/contractor-membership/bronze ($775/yr), /silver ($1,850/yr, $900 ACCA Bucks), /gold ($5,150/yr, $2,500 ACCA Bucks, unlimited ComfortU). Keep acca.org/events for the March 10-12, 2027 National Harbor date only.

claim: Finding 10 (CAI-NJ, $685): business partners "receive one category listed at no charge" in the printed directory and prior-year exhibitors get first refusal on the same booth.
problem: Neither statement is in the cited 2026 Business Partner application PDF, which confirms only the $660 + $25 = $685 dues build-up, the $39 Common Ground portion, 17% non-deductible and "membership in a local chapter is included". Both directory/booth statements are on cainj.org/faq/ instead.
fix: Add https://cainj.org/faq/ as a second source for the free printed-directory category, the paid online directory, and the prior-exhibitor booth priority; keep the application PDF for the dues arithmetic.

claim: Finding 13 (NJ Food Council): sponsor access is members-only and no prices are published (quote: "Current members of the NJ Food Council are eligible to elevate their membership to a Sponsor level").
problem: The cited URL is the events page, which carries the 2026 event dates but not the sponsorship rule or the quote. The quote is on https://www.njfoodcouncil.com/index.php/membership/become-a-sponsor, which I opened and which does support the claim (member-only sponsor elevation, benefits listed, no dollar figures).
fix: Cite become-a-sponsor for the members-only sponsorship claim and keep the events page for the calendar; optionally add join-njfc (Retail/Associate/Wholesale/Trade Association categories, no dues shown) as the source for the unpublished-dues point.

claim: Recommendation 6: "ask for the opt-in attendee list at every legal event, because the NJSBA forms state it is included at all sponsor tiers."
problem: True of the Solo and Small-Firm form (all three tiers list "attendees who have opted in"). The Family Law Symposium exhibitor form I opened mentions no attendee list at any tier, so "the NJSBA forms" overgeneralises to at least one of the two priced events.
fix: Narrow to "the Solo and Small-Firm form lists it at all three tiers; confirm it is still offered for the Family Law Symposium, whose 2026 form does not mention it."

claim: Resource "PIANJ / PIANY Annual Conference trade show": "Trade show exposure to New Jersey and New York independent agents across three days."
problem: The posted schedule shows the trade show open Sunday 4-6:30 p.m. and Monday 9-noon / 1:45-4 p.m. only; Tuesday is a fun run, breakfast and close. The conference spans three days, the trade show does not.
fix: Say "two trade-show days within a three-day conference (Sunday afternoon and Monday)".

claim: Resource "NJRHA vendor membership": "compare against the $450-per-location operator dues before committing."
problem: The $450 figure is correct but is not on the cited vendor page; it is on https://www.njrha.org/join-today (Restaurant $450 for one location, +$100 per additional location).
fix: Add the join-today URL as the source for the operator dues comparison, or drop the figure.
